Precise Numeric Values

If you want a very precise number you can enter it directly.

1. Click on the number below the knob and change the text to "23.97".
2. Notice that the text background turns red. That means it has been edited but not saved.
3. Press the ENTER key and notice that the show module is updated with the new value and the knob moves.
4. Try entering other values.
